subtitle: Lesson 45 · Data Types, Strings, and Dates

caption: string, START (1-based), length — the first 2 characters.
1-based position of the first match — or 0 if not found (not NULL).

code:
SELECT EmailAddress,
  SUBSTRING(EmailAddress, 1,
    CHARINDEX('@', EmailAddress) - 1) AS Username
FROM Person.EmailAddress;
caption: CHARINDEX finds the @ — SUBSTRING grabs everything before it, whatever the length.

subtitle: Two ways to change part of a string.
